items.d: A tiny little rock sculpture. It looks like it's 'gazing' at you inquisitively.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Mudrock.

items.d: A fine grape wine, all wrapped up. Its place of origin appears to be a very famed Columbian winery; we don't know by what means he obtained it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Mountain.

items.d: A Monastery limited commemoration badge. Meant to be bought, but just call this one a gift of friendship!
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Archetto.

items.d: A seemingly ordinary brush. Dusk's brushes can give rise to all life as well as brushstrokes. Be a little careful when using it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Dusk.

items.d: A wooden fish she carved by herself. When on edge, just chant the sutras with her.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Saga.

items.d: A postcard, upon which is a proverb written in letters you've never seen before. It seems to say, 'the only thing that comes from waiting is old age.'
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ash.

items.d: An ancient Sargon gold coin. Sent to and fro by the long hands of fate, it now belongs to you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Passenger.

items.d: A curved quill formed of cartilage. A light blue liquid drips from the quill's point, violently transforming an experimental organism's physiological structure.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Skadi the Corrupting Heart.

items.d: An unusual pocket watch, of a format never before seen in any country. Engraved on it are four dates across as many years, as well as a few crooked letters.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Kal'tsit.

items.d: A small, black device of incomprehensible makeup. The three buttons on it seem to respectively be a knife, a skull and some sort of design of a creature, and don't quite scream to be pushed.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Gladiia.

items.d: A small souvenir collected by travelers. She's spoken of the place she bought this souvenir having such good views, and that next time, she'll take you with her to see them.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Carnelian.

items.d: A Minos hero's epic. 'The hero came from the commoners, and returned to amongst the commoners.' This line, at the head of the poem, has been circled.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Pallas.

items.d: A notebook, densely packed with Ch'en's records of her investigation in Dossoles, and a few of her thoughts. She seems to be implying she's seeking your opinions, though of course, she hasn't said that outright.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ch'en the Holungday.

items.d: One of some classic video game's commemoration badges distributed for its 40th anniversary. The characters that appear on them each have completely different expressions, and are so cute you could just open wide and—
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Mizuki.

items.d: A rough, handmade piccolo. Fartooth made it herself, and it is capable of producing a few simple sounds. The craftsmanship was simple, so the prickly splinters have been meticulously smoothed over.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Fartooth.

items.d: A small segment of a dried willow branch. Each bud is still perfectly intact, as if it could grow once more if dipped into water.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Saileach.

items.d: A Kazimierzian knightly coat of arms, restored to splendor. After a meticulous polishing, the pegasus’s golden wings give off an awe-inspiring glow.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Nearl the Radiant Knight.

items.d: A seemingly mundane Kazimierzian coin. This was the sole reward Sona earned from her first victory in the underground arena.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Flametail.

items.d: A self-defense dagger he forged after his arrival at Rhodes Island. You only found out far later, by pure chance, that this is one of the ways the Edelweisses show their friendship.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Gnosis.

items.d: A ring-shaped jade pendant of unassuming appearance. You're unable to judge its value.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Lee.

items.d:
A bottle of unique body lotion. You hear it's effective in reducing static shock once applied.
Even if it's a bust, at least it's good for your skin.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Goldenglow.

items.d: A lantern. You're absolutely sure you once saw this in some late-night dream. Lanterns light the eve, arrows fall as rain, the desert flared with fire.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ling.

items.d:
A bullet-shaped hazelnut lollipop. An unofficial ration of the Laterano Notarial Hall.
Supposedly the Pope's favorite, although he claims all Lateran treats as his favorite.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Fiammetta.

items.d: A notebook. The names of several musical instruments are fastidiously written on the first page. What she's sharing with you is intel, but at the same time, memories.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Horn.

items.d: A detail-rich sculpture. Artwork only possesses meaning when left in the hands of those who know to appreciate it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Specter the Unchained.

items.d: A small chunk of ochre reef, having undergone centuries of baptism upon Iberia's coastline before being handed to you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Irene.

items.d: A simple light-emitting unit, employing some fascinating technologies. The handiwork of Lumen in his spare time. You hear the theory behind it comes from the lighthouse research notes left by his parents.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Lumen.

items.d: A Leithanian coin with a crudely drilled hole in its center. Only he knows how much sweat and tears were poured into that hole when a skilled artisan would have been able to make it effortlessly.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ebenholz.

items.d: A tube of unknown reagent identical to what flows in her body. Must never be used.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Dorothy.

items.d: An excessively dense alloy dumbbell, while appearing deceptively liftable. Gavial neglected to tell you its weight when she gave it to you, and you had to spend half an hour soothing your poor, pulled back.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Gavial the Invincible.

items.d: A pile of manuscript paper. Her strength and cowardice are written within in their fullest, nothing withheld.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Pozëmka.

items.d: A letter opener of classical design, having opened up the joys and sorrows of hundreds of lives. It's been close to the sharpest thing he's held for a long, long time.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Młynar.

items.d: Brand new zipline equipment. The parts that come in contact with the body are softer than on mass-produced ziplines, guarding against friction burns that might occur during high-speed movement.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Stainless.

items.d: A necklace of rather Siracusan stylings. As introduced to us by Texas, it is in fact a token of Signora Sicilia's. Possess it, and you possess the right to meet her. We pray the day never comes when it's needed.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Texas the Omertosa.

items.d: A solid wooden gavel. The lighter it feels when you pick it up, the more you feel its weight when you strike it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Penance.

items.d: A poetry anthology transcribed in an unfamiliar language. She does not seek for all to understand it—she simply hopes there will be a corner to reside in, for those who wish to read these poems.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Reed the Flame Shadow.

items.d: A delicate, detailed hourglass, the glass sparkling, the sand of finest grain. Time passes through overturnings and upheavals, but some things never change.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Lin.

items.d: A visitation card. It was the first time he learned that mankind regarded battle as so infused with ceremony. At this point, he no longer remembers who won or lost that bout.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Chongyue.

items.d: An ordinary whetstone. Those most common of stones, found upon the mounts and by the rivers, become smooth and sleek by the sharpening of sword's edges.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Qiubai.

items.d: A never-before-seen whetstone. Ever since you two met ages ago, Yato has never stopped to temper herself for even a moment.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Kirin R Yato.

items.d: A sharp, unassuming embroidery needle. Ines does not need anything eye-catching to prove her identity. This pointed yet lackluster object is her most appropriate justification.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ines.

items.d: A tiny figurine formed of water droplets, shaped like Muelsyse herself. So long as the reaction between you two remains, it will never dissipate.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Muelsyse.

items.d: A beautifully-designed history book. Each and every page is jampacked with her notes. By understanding history, you bring yourself closer to her.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ho'olheyak.

items.d: A pair of somewhat antiquated-looking round glasses. Some have told her that they make her look less courageous. As such, she decided to entrust her glasses to you. Aboard Rhodes Island, she wants to be her past self.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Silence the Paradigmatic.

items.d: A wireless earpiece. The latest of the Lateran Curia's tech products, and the same model that Executor himself currently uses. Is he giving this to you so you can stay in contact with him at any time, perhaps?
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Executor the Ex Foedere.

items.d: A bottle of pungently aromatic plant extract. A scent to smother civilization. Blend into the wilds; become the hunter, and become her companion.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Typhon.

items.d: A glinting, glittering gold coin. Heavy, oppressively lustrous, fabulously pure. Put it in your palm to admire, and out falls... a secret fluorescent flashbang! A self-defense gift from her to you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Swire the Elegant Wit.

items.d: A small and light piece of volcanic rock that tumbles about floating and sinking once dropped in water, gently fizzing away without end. This is the very song of Life.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Eyjafjalla the Hvít Aska.

items.d: A custom-ordered laser scope, used for precision nighttime aiming. She always has her sights set dead ahead, and never looks away.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Jessica the Liberated.

items.d: A notebook with a singed corner. Recorded are not only operation results, but the lives of Sarkaz, sifted from the ashes.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Hoederer.

items.d: A dried marigold bookmark. A book's journey is long and far; let it mark a temporary repose, the place to return to after stepping away.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Viviana.

items.d: A pair of black gloves made from fine materials, bringing calm to the instrument's strings, and to the restless sounds of the heart.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Virtuosa.

items.d: A comms terminal that can only reach her number. Doesn't look any different to a regular comms terminal, but provides infinitely more relief.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Degenbrecher.

items.d: A scrapbook, author's intent indiscernible. The 'cryptid photo' inside seems like a collaged stitch job—should somebody tell her?
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ray.

items.d: An ancient illustration reflecting the principles on which the seasons revolve, as imagined by those a millennium ago. May time drift on and turn the age; it is this still that stays the same.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Shu.

items.d: A crafted kite of distinctly Yanese make, still carrying the scent of the leaves in the trees. While the clumsy hands of its flier often cause it to fall, it will always come to rise again on the wind.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Zuo Le.

items.d: A set of goggles and noise-canceling earphones. She was not sure whether you needed the goggles at one point.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ela.

items.d: A tiny glass phial filled with smoke. Shatter with your fingers when danger looms, and Ascalon will be by your side.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ascalon.

items.d: A grenade with a smiley face scrawled on. You have no clue when this appeared in your hand. Okay, optimism: maybe it's just a beautiful firework waiting to blossom.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Wiš'adel.

items.d: A 1:1 scale replica bone pen. Useless for incanting. Very useful for copying down Rhodes Island's list of incantation victims.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Logos.

items.d: A promise to continue journeying with Rhodes Island; the only thing she can give you now. You know she'll keep her word.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Civilight Eterna.

items.d: A rock taken from a reef that has been sculpted into the shape of an anchor. The patterns etched upon it seem to represent musical notes.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ulpianus.

items.d: A stamp in the shape of a heart, able to make complex patterns. Nymph calls it 'Heart to Heart.'
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Nymph.

items.d: A homemade sleeping elixir, which came from the myriad plants of the jungle and the bandit's extensive outdoor survival experience. She sincerely hopes that you will be a good companion to her, and that her presence won't cause you to be plagued by nightmares.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Narantuya.

items.d: An expensive lotus brooch. Do not sell it, for what it represents is far more valuable than its material.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Pepe.

items.d: A magic tome filled with ideas on how to fuse Originium Arts and magic. They always seem to produce unexpected results.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Marcille.

items.d: A nameplate commemorating Rhodes Island. You feel like you've seen it before on the street corners of Londinium post-reconstruction. The rivets are exceedingly familiar. She says that once they're installed, they can never be removed.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Vina Victoria.

items.d: An extremely elegant purple invitation, with a white wolf and a grape scrawled on the corner. She has invited you to a party, but no one knows what the party is about.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Lappland the Decadenza.

items.d: An airtight black tactical mask. 'My face is concealed, but my anger is for all to see.'
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Crownslayer.

items.d: A set of handmade tassels. You're not sure if it's a Siracusan or Higashinese tradition, but Vulpisfoglia gave them to you to show her respect and gratitude.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Vulpisfoglia.

items.d: An unusual knot tied from some cloth. Trust binds together the two ends, binds past and future.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Lessing.

items.d: A fine strand of Corazonix, quietly flowing through your bloodstream. Once Thorns recalls it, he will know every single change happening inside your body.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Thorns the Lodestar.

items.d: A blank menu, with which you can book a dinner for one with Yu as the chef. Seeing it is enough to get some people drooling.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Yu.

items.d: A portable oven, able to be lit and cook food in an instant. Whenever the two of you are stuck working overtime all night, she'll give you half the instant noodles she cooks.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Blaze the Igniting Spark.

items.d: A silver chain with nothing attached. You and she are not yet at your closest, but when you are, she will take the memory, congeal it into a crystal of blood, and present it to you once more.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Entelechia.

items.d: A collection of stories that was never published, all of them missing an ending. Closer inspection reveals that these incomplete tales all point towards someone still among the living. You're part of one of them yourself.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Necrass.

items.d: A metal construct that can change its shape, originally suspended beside Mon3tr's body. It can aid you in times of trouble. It will remind you of many things.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Mon3tr.

items.d: An Indisputable Boss of Bosses medal. Five Best Boss medals can be exchanged for a Super Boss medal, and collect a hundred Super Boss medals for an Indisputable Boss of Bosses medal. When asked if these medal upgrades will continue any further, Exusiai simply smiles.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Exusiai the New Covenant.

items.d: An apple and a pot of soil. Eat it, then plant it. Once it blooms, she hopes you will send her its flowers.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Lemuen.

items.d: A bright, shining badge, proof of his many years of service protecting Laterano, and proof of the inexhaustible trust the Holy City places in him.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Sankta Miksaparato.

items.d: A gold leaf, sporting incredibly realistic venation. You recognize it from the ornate wreath around Phantom's ears, often seen bathing in the spotlight. Drama comes naturally to him.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Tragodia.

items.d: A suppressive talisman of the Five Thunders. This is not a form of admonishment, but rather, her blessing to you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Leizi the Thunderbringer.

items.d: A piece of some obscure metallic element. Apparently a part of Axie's core structure. She says it is a leftover from when the machine's accuracy was being upgraded, like a baby tooth falling out.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Raidian.

items.d: A stack of sticky notes shaped like finbeasts. She says she records her schedule on them to use as reminders. Once she's said her part, she looks at you with interest, curious as to what you will write on them.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Haruka.

items.d: A worn-out L.G.D. Inspector's badge holder. She's kept these holders, but this is the first time she's given one to someone else.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Hoshiguma the Breacher.

items.d: A doll precious to Sakiko that often rests quietly atop her piano, watching over her from where it's sat.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Sakiko Togawa.

items.d: An upgraded transceiver that helps her 'communicate' with others more easily. Wear it if you want her to respond to your thoughts from time to time.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Mantra.

items.d: A scabbard for his blade. Made of Originium Ice Crystals, it will never crack.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of SilverAsh the Reignfrost.

items.d: A wooden box for storing perfumes, carrying the scent of Vine-Bead Court incense. She gifted it to you in accordance with how the Kjerags treat their close friends.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Pramanix the Prerita.

items.d: A script without a name on it, a narrow door to a new realm. She placed it on your desk one morning.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Astgenne the Lightchaser.

items.d: A bone pen shaped like a branch, useful for aiding delicate work. Nasti says not to worry too much just because of its unsettling name, and she can always get you a new one if it snaps.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Nasti.

items.d: A blank ostracon with no marks on either side. Titi gave it to you for safekeeping—show it to her when necessary to keep her humble and alert.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Titi.

items.d: A small, shiny, and jet-black stone. You tried to sand it down into a weiqi piece, but the sudden sensation of being torn apart stopped you in your tracks.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Wang.

items.d: A plain copper guard for a sword, forged for protection in actual combat. A common sight in Yanese martial tales, and an embodiment of many a youth's aspirations.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ch'en the Dawnstreak.

items.d: A keen-edged dagger. Finds use in assassination, brawling, intimidation, and of course, peeling apples.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Bellone.

items.d: A stone shard, seemingly once part of a statue. By Zima's account, she bet a hell of a lot on this shard, and has faith it'll be the start of a new age.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Zima the Raging Tide.

items.d: A reference book which tells how to recognize and use Originium Arts. Most Operators don't understand it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ptilopsis.

items.d: A strip of cloth ripped from a red flag. When you tie it to your arm, you will somehow feel sad.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Zima.

items.d: The scutcheon of Texas's family. The scratch on it tells a story.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Texas.

items.d: An itinerary. There are too many destinations on it so it's hard to stick to it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Franka.

items.d: A can of salted licorice with a long shelf life. Under that inaccessible appearance is an even more inaccessible taste.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Indra.

items.d: Several bloodstained scutcheons with names on them. They represent the leaders of several gangs.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Lappland.

items.d: An indescribable painting. The use of negative space is confusing.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Specter.

items.d: A shopping card from a high-class clothing shop. Put away the boring uniforms and enjoy dressing up.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Blue Poison.

items.d: Two tickets to the amusement park. Let's go together this weekend.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Platinum.

items.d: A letter from the Sarkaz children you saved. They haphazardly express their gratitude to Rhodes Island.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Meteorite.

items.d: 'You will understand my choice one day... Forgive me.'
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Amiya.

items.d: A glass bead that feels cool. The colors inside are raging.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Skyfire.

items.d: A mini Meeboo model. There is a red button in its belly. Hmm...
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Mayer.

items.d: A patterned feather decoration. This ineloquent researcher from Liberi shows her sincerity by gifting her own feathers.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Silence.

items.d: A mysterious liquid sealed inside a small transparent bottle. Ropy and shiny, this red matter changes its form slowly as you shake the bottle.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Warfarin.

items.d: An old, discolored Kazimierz knight badge. The Pegasus made of niello is fluttering its wings.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Nearl.

items.d: A pointed baby tooth. Hope you can take good care of it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Projekt Red.

items.d: A tailor-made insulative bracelet. A safe handshake, finally.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Liskarm.

items.d: A business card with a cute style. Different from normal ones, it has a QR code for receiving money and a remark 'Thank You!'
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Croissant.

items.d: A steel billet with beautiful patterns. No matter the quality of the raw materials, shaping them always requires hardening and polishing.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Vulcan.

items.d: A multifunctional cleaning machine. Most of the time, it is used to clean the hair shed from operators' tails.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Provence.

items.d: A simple harmonica. The moment the melodious tweedle sounds, the leaves fall like rain.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Firewatch.

items.d: A handmade rope ring. Three ropes twine around each other tightly.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Cliffheart.

items.d: A small silver bell. It emits refreshing tinkles when stroked by the breeze.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Pramanix.

items.d: A book on the war history of Ursus. It's said the author has been exiled to Leithanien.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Istina.

items.d: The first single CD Sora released when she debuted as an idol. It is a kids song from a cartoon, but you can still feel she put her heart and soul into it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Sora.

items.d: A violet envelope sealed with a morning glory sticker. Open it and you will find a piece of folded paper saying 'Please be my friend.'
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Manticore.

items.d: A poster of an action movie. The star looks a bit familiar.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of FEater.

items.d: A red police whistle. Blow it and you will feel a sense of justice puffing up your chest.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Grani.

items.d: A cute doll commonly seen in shops. It will look different if placed somewhere dark.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Nightmare.

items.d: A broken police badge. An unknown officer lost it during an important case. No one can tell whose it is, but someone must stand up for justice.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Swire.

items.d: A pen filled with special ink. A thousand stars twinkle brightly the moment the pen touches paper.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Astesia.

items.d: A notebook with no more space to write. Here one finds all extant knowledge on Originium research. It's so detailed that it could be published as a book titled Originium Research: From Basics to Mastery.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ceylon.

items.d: A dead battery. The final purpose of a useless item is to be part of a collection.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Glaucus.

items.d: A family seal that has been wiped down so many times that its pattern is fading, still polished and shining impeccably.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Breeze.

items.d: An old, bloodstained coat that has burn marks. Can't tell whose blood it is.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Flamebringer.

items.d: A self-defense manual, with comprehensive descriptions of things to pay attention to in most major city-states. Focuses mostly on personal safety and very little on the well-being of the inhabitants.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Executor.

items.d: A short poem written on diary paper. The handwriting is beautiful and delicate, but the words are painful and harrowing.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Reed.

items.d: An exquisite miniature landscape model of an ancient Siracusan city. Someone stealthily placed it on your desk at some point, and you didn't discover it until you showed up for work the next day.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Broca.

items.d: An old martial arts scroll written in an undiscernable text. At least it'll have some value as a reference material... right?
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Waai Fu.

items.d: A weathered map. The traces of countless miles of voyages are clearly visible, where new plans interweave with past markings. This is the life of a Messenger.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Bison.

items.d: A broken scalpel, the father's memento. It is difficult to imagine that a doctor who did so much to help the Infected would end up suffering so much torment.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of GreyThroat.

items.d: A self-authored and compiled cookbook. Its recipes are suitable for any season, featuring dishes that are both easy-to-make and delicious.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Hung.

items.d: A hand-sewn purse that contains small coins no longer in circulation.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Snowsant.

items.d: An old oak ruler. No ruler markings, no rules.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Leizi.

items.d: A pendant etched with runes, its decoration exaggerated and full of obsession with the past.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Sesa.

items.d: A rough worker's shirt, from when Bibeak first learned to sew. It may not be comfortable to wear, but the heart and soul it exudes is unmistakable.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Bibeak.

items.d: A necklace made of a string of opals. Hopefully, you will be able to deliver it to its intended recipient.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Savage.

items.d: An apple with a bite taken out of it. Small teeth marks are still clearly visible.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Shamare.

items.d: This shiny figurine seems to hold great significance to Minosians. The patron god of travelers, protector of Sideroca, may now be watching over you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Sideroca.

items.d: A complex and hand-drawn topographic map. If you can't make any sense of it, perhaps Elysium would be glad to lead the way.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Elysium.

items.d: A spare spelunking suit. She seems to be implying that if you have the time, you're free to take a walk with her.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Asbestos.

items.d: A protective charm made by Tsukinogi. Rumors have it that carrying it calms the spirit and dispels the fear of the darkest nights.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Tsukinogi.

items.d: A large Ursus-style tactical vest. It didn't fit its previous owner well, but she rarely took it off.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Absinthe.

items.d: A pair of trendy limited-edition sneakers. It seems to include a special auxiliary design to accommodate one of Victoria's popular sports, with technical support from Rim Billiton.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Leonhardt.

items.d: A self-authored reconnaissance and counter-reconnaissance manual. His thought process was, 'it's best to keep yourself protected under any circumstance.'
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ayerscarpe.

items.d: A popular science poster that explains a variety of subclinical health conditions in detail, along with their treatment methods. Printed on the reverse side are a large number of appalling real cases, for reasons one may never know.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Folinic.

items.d: A full set of horn care supplies, including essential oils, soft brushes, and sandpaper strips. Custom-made by desert tribes, incredibly expensive and hard to find, you can just use it for a manicure - as long as you can stomach the cost.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Beeswax.

items.d: A badge that he made himself, representing the 'Chiave Gang.' Your name is also engraved upon it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Chiave.

items.d: A brand new camera. True scenic beauty must be captured in person.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Scene.

items.d: A handmade model gun, painstakingly crafted by the Operator herself.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Andreana.

items.d: A dreamcatcher that gives off a comforting fragrance, made by Tomimi herself. Only after a good night's sleep is she able to give her best - this is Tomimi's exclusive secret.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Tomimi.

items.d: A sharp stone dagger made by Flint herself, normally used by the owner to carve roasted meat. While useful for a variety of outdoor environments, be careful not to cut yourself!
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Flint.

items.d: An album including the song 'April,' still freshly packaged and tied up in a lovely ribbon.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of April.

items.d: An aged hardback book. No one knows if the book will bite until it actually does.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Mint.

items.d: A Siracusan-style fedora handcrafted by the man himself. The fabric used in its construction is of very high quality, a clear example of his fine attention to detail.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Aosta.

items.d: A supplementary VIP credit card issued by Golden Palm Bank Kazimierz. Incredibly high limit. Accepted without question in all major cities of Kazimierz.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Whislash.

items.d: An old-fashioned cinema ticket stub. The proof of a single memory. The ink on it falling off, old and yellowing, becoming indistinct with age.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Whisperain.

items.d: An assiduously cared-for bonsai. Attached is a card, upon which is written: 'I buried a knife in here. It can peel apples, if you ever need.'
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Kafka.

items.d: A still-sealed knife. Its design is exquisite, and there are letters engraved on the handle. It appears to be a limited-run tie-in for a movie.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Robin.

items.d: A manually bound book of fairytales. A collection never released to the market, each illustration hand-drawn by its creator.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Iris.

items.d: A vial of nutritional fluid. Hand crafted by the outstanding medical operator Tuye, it gives off a peculiar smell. Whether and when to drink it remain questions you have to think over for yourself.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Tuye.

items.d: A paper fan, its frame made of special materials, on it written 'nonexistent and nothing.'
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Mr. Nothing.

items.d: A sheath covered in scars. The once distinctive patterns she'd engraved herself have been worn away through constant use, the lines now invisible.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Lava the Purgatory.

items.d: A complete set of linguistics books and comprehensive, well-organized notes. They seem to annotate comparisons between nouns across different languages.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Blitz.

items.d: A set of handmade survival tools. She wants to convey to you that survival is a matter of skill, not brute force.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Frost.

items.d: A set of dolls made from wood and the carapace of Originium slugs. Starting from the largest doll, they can be nestled within each other.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Tachanka.

items.d: A delicately cut icosahedral crystal gemstone. By her logic, things you slough off onto others in passing can't be called gifts.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Toddifons.

items.d: A small-form shield, apparently personally forged under Vulcan's guidance. Very lightweight, but very firm.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Heavyrain.

items.d: A helping of raw, worked meat. Only those who eat heartily and leave an empty plate can be called good buddies.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Akafuyu.

items.d: [Shinobi Ex Machina 2] Collector's Edition. The launch collector's edition of a classic Higashi game. She's dying to share all her favorites with you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Kirara.

items.d: A set of fine pocket-sized clothing. Not wearable by humans, but they can be stood up on your desk as display items.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Bena.

items.d: A copy of the 'Dossoles Guide to Cocktails,' with plenty of recipes full of her notes on the side. These all seem to be her specialties—if you've got time to spare, you can order a round from her.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of La Pluma.

items.d: A nameplate with a full name and date inscribed. Ever since the day he obtained it, Tequila has always carried it on him. Now's the time for him to let it go.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Tequila.

items.d: Adorned with Yan's characteristic red protective charms. Mulberry asked for this amulet back specifically for you. Incomprehensible Yan characters are written on it, and an almost imperceptible scent of incense seems to linger.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Mulberry.

items.d: A shell casing left over from a shot, bearing Ashlock's signature. This once brought her victory, and now, it belongs to you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ashlock.

items.d: A berry plant grown by Honeyberry. Its form has beauty, its fruits are tart, sweet and delicious, and the whole of it can be used medicinally. A new, never-before-found cultivar.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Honeyberry.

items.d: A splinter of the major lance's damaged outer shell, kept preciously safe by Wild Mane. A reminder to herself that every battle comes with a cost, and you need to think things through.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Wild Mane.

items.d: A reagent bottle with label after label thickly pasted over it. 'Anti-corrosive coating reagent,' 'anti-anti-corrosive coating reagent,' 'anti-anti-...anti-anti-corrosive coating reagent,' the font is smaller and smaller. Er, seriously?
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Corroserum.

items.d: A combination lock. You can open the toolbox she carries, and you're allowed to use the stuff inside.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Aurora.

items.d: A hand-knitted scarf. The materials are excessive, and you'd find it hot even wearing it in Kjerag. No unusual features at all, just the craftsmanship that goes into knitting a fine scarf like this is already enough to make you gasp in admiration.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Kjera.

items.d: A shattered emblem, upon it carved the Crimson Troupe's design. Shalem preserves this part of the past, as if he long foresaw a day he'd hand it over.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Shalem.

items.d: A knitted nightcap. It's made roughly, but is very soft to the touch.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Blacknight.

items.d: An vacant flowerpot filled only with soil. The soil was brought from the earth of her homeland. If you're ever at leisure, you can go ask her for some seeds.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Quercus.

items.d:
A sucker arrow, several small bells tied to the fletching.
With this arrow, you can provide a name, and so long as it's present on Rhodes Island and can be shot, she'll land this straight on the target.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Kroos the Keen Glint.

items.d: A vividly colored pendant that rustles. Handcrafted by Kazemaru herself.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Kazemaru.

items.d:
A can of sugar-free coffee. Portable and ready to drink.
The finest choice for those times when you can't make coffee, but need a caffeine boost. That is, if you can stand its bitter taste.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Enforcer.

items.d: A crudely assembled pair of scissors, rarely used. Meant for snipping bindings. Guard of the past, she wishes to see you off as you head for the future.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Rockrock.

items.d: A notebook comprised of awkward handwriting and yellowed pages. She often still dreams of sitting at her writing desk in the County of Toron, the forest of oaks beyond her window blanketed by the snowstorm.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Heidi.

items.d: A case of wear-resistant adhesive bandages, carried on Windflit's person. Used until worn-through, and then he's plus one callus, minus one plaster.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Windflit.

items.d: A notebook filled with mythic legends and poems for the wayward bard. The language isn't flowery per se, but passion and sincerity abound as you read it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Erato.

items.d: A small flower folded from paper. It has become Hibiscus's habit to leave a small memento like this next to the bed of each patient as they are about to be discharged.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Hibiscus the Purifier.

items.d: An old-fashioned, time-worn metronome that has accompanied Czerny since his brief yet happy formative years.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Czerny.

items.d: A dissertation. These few sheets of paper depict the young Perro's ideals over the past few years.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Greyy the Lightningbearer.

items.d: A handmade model of a comet. Let the past be the past and instead take hold of the future.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Astgenne.

items.d: A small lyre, all weapons removed. Can tug heartstrings with simply a strum, bringing your thoughts back down in the heat of chaos.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Cantabile.

items.d: A pencil stub, worn beyond further use. At the end of its life, it has drawn up the most wondrous designs.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Minimalist.

items.d: A book of analysis of Kazimierz law, rife with notes. Countless underlines stress key points, growing steadily more useless the more they're made.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Proviso.

items.d: A pure white conch shell. Clasp it in the quiet night and lift it to your ear, and you'll seem to hear a distant song of farewell.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Highmore.

items.d: Fluffy ear mufflers. Lovely and warm in the cold, they'll keep your whole body safe and were hand-knitted by the girl herself.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Paprika.

items.d: A page from the Book of the Tower Knights. On it is Isabelle 'Dagda' Montague's name, followed by a large blank space below, waiting to be filled in.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Dagda.

items.d: A beautiful bouquet of dried flowers, picked in the frigid northern wilds. Fragrance lingers about the petals, never failing to remind Qanipalaat of home.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Qanipalaat.

items.d: A bone arrowhead, seemingly polished by Lunacub herself. When asked of the bone's origins, Lunacub states she found it while outside.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Lunacub.

items.d: An invitation letter to a dance from some high-up nobility. Attached is an exhaustively detailed list of invitees paired with profiles, which of course you're not among.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Harmonie.

items.d: A blank white jigsaw puzzle. Questioning who he is may well be a fruitless endeavor—try asking him what the order he seeks is.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Puzzle.

items.d: A jar of pungent, biting unstrained wine. Temperatures plummet in the desert at night, and drinking this can drive away some of the chill.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Jieyun.

items.d: A seemingly unremarkable lighter. You never thought somebody would have ten whole tricks to play with just a single flame.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Firewhistle.

items.d: A small copper-forged bell, worked slightly such that a little force is required for it to ring. Her worry was that an unsympathetic wind might sound the bell, rousing the far-flung traveler's heart for home.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Wind Chimes.

items.d: A portable BBQ spit fit for bags of any size, usable at any time. Noir Corne spent a long time finding the trick to grilling the best meat, and he truly believes this skill will come in handy someday.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Rathalos S Noir Corne.

items.d: A single loose leaf sheet filled with neat handwriting. As written, the Glasgow Gang's code for getting along cannot be clearer, but Morgan understands that it is naive to think that everyone will follow it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Morgan.

items.d: A tattered and scuffed safety helmet. If you don't wear it properly, Cement won't let you follow her into the mines.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Cement.

items.d: A huge tub of chocolate-flavored energy shake powder, normally mixed with milk as a late-night snack. Although once commonly found across Columbian sundries stores a decade ago, it has since become much less common.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Melanite.

items.d: A handwritten dessert recipe. With proportions finetuned to Insider's own personal tastes, the sugar content ABSOLUTELY exceeds recommended guidelines! This one's a pick-me-up!
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Insider.

items.d: A user manual for precision machinery. Though the only thing inside is a special phone number, since she thinks telling you what to do directly is easier. (But sometimes she'll teach you wrong on purpose—depends on her mood.)
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Spuria.

items.d: A curiously carved marker of wood. You recall Santalla once telling you how it signifies 'warmth.'
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Santalla.

items.d: An eternal flame, its lighting element of the same material as her staff. She may be able to see in the dark, but she's not sure about you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Valarqvin.

items.d: A thumb-sized surfboard, printed with the 'White Volcano' logo. It's a decoration he dresses cocktails with. May this prompt you to look back fondly on your unforgettable vacation to Siesta's sands.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Bryophyta.

items.d: The littlest, most verdant citrus, its peel not enough to fully hide its tart fragrance. She tells you you can plant it in a pot, and with some luck it'll bear sweet, decadent fruits—probably.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Poncirus.

items.d: A metal whistle that makes a shrill sound when blown hard. Quite the wake-up call. 'Yoo-hoooo—let's get to work!'
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Almond.

items.d: A chunk of ice carved into a globe, a perfect fit for the glass it sits in. To those interested in trying her homebrew, we suggest you take it on the rocks to water it down. Or better yet, DON'T try it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Coldshot.

items.d: A refined cufflink. Servicemen of Windermere lineage have always been fastidious about their martial appearances, with not a hair out of place. Now, she's removed this small token of her own accord, and gifted it to you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Delphine.

items.d: A withered white rose, cream-colored petals stained by irremovable traces of deep red, reflecting certain recollections of her past life. Bygones are bygones, and there is so little she can hold onto.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Vendela.

items.d: A simple gemstone magnifying glass that has seen many years of use. Find the traces of forgery, and identify my true nature.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Diamante.

items.d: The mouthpiece of a tuba. Bassline has rubbed it clean and restored its former sheen.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Bassline.

items.d: A bottle of honey beverage, emblematic of the taste of home. The moment Leto hands you this, she's gonna tell you 'chug.'
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Leto.

items.d: A bottle of discerningly selected perfume. From what goes into it to how to use it, Harold has explained each aspect to you in laborious enough detail to drive one up the wall.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Harold.

items.d: A tiny little freight truck, made out of a candy wrapper. For each Rim Billy sweet you've given Warmy in your journey, she's transformed it and gifted it back to you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Warmy.

items.d: An exquisite model of a Tianshi apparatus, reportedly sold in limited runs by the Tianshi Bureaus to great fanfare among the children of Yan. Variations of 'you'd better study hard if you want one' ring in the ears of every Yanese child.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Wanqing.

items.d: A handmade bamboo flute. Pure and clear of timbre, but the tuning is mildly suspect.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Grain Buds.

items.d: A rustic scimitar. Regarding you as a friend in arms, the tribal warrior of Sargon gifts you this.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Kestrel.

items.d: Contact lenses for everyday use. Does not endow you with the power of Gemini, but things do seem to look a little sharper.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Iana.

items.d: A shotgun shell. He regrets that the conflict had to be resolved that way, but he did not hesitate, not when even more lives were at stake.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Doc.

items.d: An unusual helmet. You often wonder what his expression is behind the mask.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Fuze.

items.d: An appointment form for cleaning services, with a list of different scented detergents and their respective use cases. Call her when you need her, and she'll know which one will leave you a happy customer.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Aroma.

items.d: A sweet potato roasted in a pile of fallen leaves. Very hot—take care when holding.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Odda.

items.d: A big ol' windbreaker. Gotta keep the wind out and stay warm while you're active in the wilderness.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Fang the Fire-Sharpened.

items.d: A hand-made coupon. She has so many ideas that she could not decide on what to gift; she makes something on the spot based on her mood at the time when you redeem the coupon.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Lucilla.

items.d: A simple metal folder that automatically sorts documents based on rules set by the user. Underflow seems to want you to use it for the reports she submits.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Underflow.

items.d: Dessert coupon that gives 50% off on the second serving. Mitm was very insistent that you bring him along when you use this coupon.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Mitm.

items.d: An entirely unremarkable nut. You keep looking back and forth towards it and Tin Man, trying to figure out where it fell from.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Tin Man.

items.d: A clockwork fowlbeast that picks up shiny stuff. It has a sharp eye like its maker, but your office is not any tidier for it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Sand Reckoner.

items.d: A copy of 'Tentative Travel Plans (Third Edition).' Her travels began with an encounter with Rhodes Island. Wish her a smooth journey.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Papyrus.

items.d: A strange painting depicting what seems to be a chimeric creature that blends the features of all sorts of Terran wildlife into one. If Laios starts explaining this masterpiece to you, resist the urge to show interest—it only encourages his enthusiasm.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Laios.

items.d: A bottle of seasoning Senshi carries around with him, containing a unique flavor from that distant dungeon.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Senshi.

items.d: A small waist pouch, able to hold all sorts of things. Very handy when it comes to exploring.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Chilchuck.

items.d: A giant plushie as tall as a person and full of soft stuffing. After a tight hug, it will slowly regain its shape. Life is stressful, and finding a way to self-adjust is key.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Bobbing.

items.d: A small windup alarm clock made from surplus materials, both a Highbury children's toy and a timer for explosives. It's yours now.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Catherine.

items.d: A type of incense used during meditation. It is said that the plant it is made from exhausts the water supply in sandy soil as it grows. Now it exhausts itself, all to help with your meditation.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Philae.

items.d: A pitted silver ring. It seems it once belonged to a mafioso, but it has been used as a thimble for a very long time.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Figurino.

items.d: A wad of medicinal herbs with a bizarre scent, said to promote concentration and calm the spirit when burned. Better not use it before Medical gets the chance to identify it!
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Rose Salt.

items.d: A small puppet with burning red cheeks, its big round eyes reminding you of Tecno whenever she's pleading for something.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Tecno.

items.d: A map of Columbia with a few locations circled, along with photos of the beautiful sights that can be found there. Maybe she'll bring you along for the next trip.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Surfer.

items.d: A jade chopstick rest. Let your chopsticks wander to seek new flavors, let them rest to savor the taste.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Xingzhu.

items.d: A pair of foldable non-corrective glasses with a brass frame. While the style may have once been popular, it is rarely ever picked by opticians today.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Nowell.

items.d: A beautiful chunk of ore. According to Wulfenite, it can change color. May as well have a look whenever you have some spare time. You might be pleasantly surprised.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Wulfenite.

items.d: An intricate knot woven from straw, its meaning unwritten in any book. It's not often that straw ropes are coated in beastoil. Maybe she just doesn't want you cutting yourself on the sharp blades of grass.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Brigid.

items.d: A multi-functional spanner, the very first thing Alanna made on her own with a CNC tool. She's given this unique gift to you, with a reminder that the miniature hammer at its tip is perfect for cracking open nuts.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Alanna.

items.d: A pot of fresh lilies, transplanted from Operator Gracebearer's flowerbed. She was always good at tending to newly-bloomed flowers.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Gracebearer.

items.d: A spray can—Psssh—With it, you can draw whatever you like on the wall. Just be sure not to spray random doodles or whatever.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Tippi.

items.d: A badge marked with a pawprint. You hung it around Miss.Christine's neck, but the next day, it was back on your desk.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Miss.Christine.

items.d: A bottle of powerful medicine for combat injuries, though its sting when applied is more painful than the injury itself. Luckily, he is an expert at applying it, and even better at comforting the wounded.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Record Keeper.

items.d: A few stickers with trendy designs, part of a set Kichisei added to whenever she ate at a ramen shop, though one is hand-drawn. She says she never managed to find that last design, but she still wanted you to have a full set.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Kichisei.

items.d: An elaborate business card. By holding on to it, you will know where to find him... or perhaps it will let him know where to find you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Matsukiri.

items.d: An ordinary, fresh cucumber, so lovingly grown that one hesitates to eat it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Mutsumi Wakaba.

items.d: A star chart that Uika studies by lamplight, referencing it against the starry night above.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Uika Misumi.

items.d: A favorite cosmetics set of Nyamu's. Brims with her desire to become even more charming along with her friends.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Nyamu Yūtenji.

items.d: A protein drink. To most Rhodes Island operators, this is just a nutritious supplement, but to Umiri, it is a staple foodstuff.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Umiri Yahata.

items.d: A hand made bronze 'bell' with a well polished surface and smooth edges. A replica of the one that stayed by her side at the mines and on the ice. She entrusts it to you now.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Vetochki.

items.d: A small tuft of the Rift Cloudbeast's fur. She said if you ever find yourself lost in the snowy mountains, she and her Rift Cloudbeast will find you and lead you out of the blinding blizzard. She is sure she can do it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Snow Hunter.

items.d: A uniquely shaped blade fragment from her staff. Hadiya promised you this shard will one day become a passage permit recognized by all desert dwellers.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Hadiya.

items.d: A 'Dr Oxygen' bottle cap. It was your deposit when you first hired her, and now it's your membership badge for her travel agency.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Cairn.

items.d: A bulky cannon-like high-magnification telescope. He says one day he'll lead all of Columbia to conquer the skies, and you better not miss it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Skybox.

items.d: Several unidentified seeds from Minos. Lena's letter didn't mention how to grow them, but you are certain they will thrive in the Convalescent Garden.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Perfumer the Distilled.

items.d: A navigational chart riddled with notes. He knows the rivers marked here no longer exist, though they still continue to flow within him.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Varkáris.

items.d: A ruler and compass set. Ju always says no one can best him at drawing circles, and would like to share this unremarkable ability with you. After all, mortal affairs often transpire under unassuming eyes, do they not?
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ju.

items.d: A dandelion flower head, picked up by Taraxacum on his way to Rhodes Island. A small handwritten note below reads: 'Not For Medicinal Use.'
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Taraxacum.

items.d: An orchestra staff pass, hand-drawn. Ripresa presented this to you with utmost seriousness, promising that simply showing it will grant you free admission to any of their concerts.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ripresa.

items.d: A jet-black, shiny glass orb. Its making is a mystery, but it is very heavy and very round. According to Ukusik, it is part of her prized collection, and must not be handed off to anyone else.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ukusik.

items.d: A telescopic mini-antenna, and also seemingly a hair clip? Botani handed it to you with no explanation, though she did give a covert giggle.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Botani.

items.d: A serving spoon. Its companion fork has been hidden inside a book.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Haze.

items.d: A card from a divination deck. Although you already know its meaning, you make your own future.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Gitano.

items.d: A photo commemorating Jessica's entry into Blacksteel. It represents the start of a new life.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Jessica.

items.d: A garland made of twigs that seem to never wither. The forest of Kazimierz is asking in a low voice when its guardian will return.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Meteor.

items.d: A calligraphic work whose ink has not yet dried. It's a blessing for Rhodes Island.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Shirayuki.

items.d: A bottle of malt liquor found somewhere far away. Under the sunlight, the golden liquid shines inside the glass bottle.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Courier.

items.d: A silver coin. Maybe you can use it to decide something important.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Scavenger.

items.d: An electric guitar for daily practice. A request to take it onto the battlefield was denied.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Vigna.

items.d: A red pamphlet. It records a tough battle.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Dobermann.

items.d: A pair of soft blinders. It's nice to put it on at bedtime.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Matoimaru.

items.d: A vocabulary book that looks timeworn due to overuse. Detailed marks that look like doodles fill the margins of every page.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Frostleaf.

items.d: A stone comb. It feels cool and emits a slight flowery fragrance.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Estelle.

items.d: An album whose cover is decorated with golden floral patterns. The photos inside record the 'kitties' that played with the photographer. Kitties!
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Mousse.

items.d: A badly worn Kazimierz knight badge. No matter what happened in the past, seizing the here and now is what really matters.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Gravel.

items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Mr. Nothing.

items.d: A delicately cut icosahedral crystal gemstone. By her logic, things you slough off onto others in passing can't be called gifts.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Toddifons.

items.d: A helping of raw, worked meat. Only those who eat heartily and leave an empty plate can be called good buddies.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Akafuyu.

items.d: [Shinobi Ex Machina 2] Collector's Edition. The launch collector's edition of a classic Higashi game. She's dying to share all her favorites with you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Kirara.

items.d: A copy of the 'Dossoles Guide to Cocktails,' with plenty of recipes full of her notes on the side. These all seem to be her specialties—if you've got time to spare, you can order a round from her.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of La Pluma.

items.d: Adorned with Yan's characteristic red protective charms. Mulberry asked for this amulet back specifically for you. Incomprehensible Yan characters are written on it, and an almost imperceptible scent of incense seems to linger.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Mulberry.

items.d: A shell casing left over from a shot, bearing Ashlock's signature. This once brought her victory, and now, it belongs to you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ashlock.

items.d: A reagent bottle with label after label thickly pasted over it. 'Anti-corrosive coating reagent,' 'anti-anti-corrosive coating reagent,' 'anti-anti-...anti-anti-corrosive coating reagent,' the font is smaller and smaller. Er, seriously?
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Corroserum.

items.d: A combination lock. You can open the toolbox she carries, and you're allowed to use the stuff inside.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Aurora.

items.d: A serving spoon. Its companion fork has been hidden inside a book.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Haze.

items.d: A card from a divination deck. Although you already know its meaning, you make your own future.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Gitano.

items.d: A photo commemorating Jessica's entry into Blacksteel. It represents the start of a new life.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Jessica.

items.d: A garland made of twigs that seem to never wither. The forest of Kazimierz is asking in a low voice when its guardian will return.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Meteor.

items.d: A calligraphic work whose ink has not yet dried. It's a blessing for Rhodes Island.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Shirayuki.

items.d: A silver coin. Maybe you can use it to decide something important.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Scavenger.

items.d: An electric guitar for daily practice. A request to take it onto the battlefield was denied.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Vigna.

items.d: A red pamphlet. It records a tough battle.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Dobermann.

items.d: A pair of soft blinders. It's nice to put it on at bedtime.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Matoimaru.

items.d: A vocabulary book that looks timeworn due to overuse. Detailed marks that look like doodles fill the margins of every page.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Frostleaf.

items.d: An album whose cover is decorated with golden floral patterns. The photos inside record the 'kitties' that played with the photographer. Kitties!
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Mousse.

items.d: A badly worn Kazimierz knight badge. No matter what happened in the past, seizing the here and now is what really matters.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Gravel.

items.d: An expensive ornament whose price tag is still on it. Is it really okay to take it...?
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Rope.

items.d: A pill made from multiple herbs. It will come in handy when you fall ill. Besides, every pill is carefully coated.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Myrrh.

items.d: A double ear vase in the style of the Minos civilization. The owner must regularly replace the old flowers with new ones.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Perfumer.

items.d: A wooden statue that looks a bit rough. It is lowering its head, which gives a peaceful impression.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Matterhorn.

items.d: A normal baseball bat bearing the illegible autographs of several famous players on it. Maybe, perhaps, those signatures are fake, but the desire to share them is real.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Cuora.

items.d: A discount coupon for Gummy's Breakfast Kitchen. Does -100% mean it's free...?
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Gummy.

items.d: A freehand fairy tale storybook. The main character, after traveling between life and death, finally steps into the river at the end.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Deepcolor.

items.d: A small piece of weirdly-shaped ore. Put it beside your ear to hear the low sounds of a liquid.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Earthspirit.

items.d: A stamp album. In the past, the owner never let anyone touch her precious collection.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Shaw.

items.d: A boxing trophy. The named carved on the base is already worn, but the trophy itself still emits a prideful light.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Beehunter.

items.d: A delicate LED lamp. Embed 1 Originium Shard and it will shine forever. Let it dispel the anxiety brought by darkness.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Greyy.

items.d: A long rod that she chose herself, but it doesn't seem any different from the stick in her hand. She looks to be pretty satisfied with this gift, even though it doesn't have any particular use.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Myrtle.

items.d: A diary made from soft paper. Whether the words record the past or the future, it will always be there as long as it's recorded, right?
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Sussurro.

items.d: A pearly-white string of trophies carved from animal, including one from the beast that took her arm.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Vermeil.

items.d: It's not clear where this taser came from. It can be grouped with May's other commonly-used weapons.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of May.

items.d: A mirror with exquisite craftsmanship. It is easy to carry, letting you make sure that your hair isn't getting messed up in the heat of battle.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ambriel.

items.d: A black box. Inside it is another black box. Inside that is another black box. Inside that is... a manicure set?!
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Utage.

items.d: A hand-carved talisman full of notch marks from when the maker accidentally applied too much force.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Cutter.

items.d: A pack of flower seeds, capable of transforming your office into a flowery sanctuary. As long as you're not allergic to anything, anywhere can become the Convalescent Garden.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Podenco.

items.d: A compact disc full of popular videos produced by Click in recent years. Contains highlights and uncut content, with some entirely unedited videos.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Click.

items.d: A kitchen knife forged from stainless steel. Probably cost quite a lot of money.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Jaye.

items.d: A brand new skateboard that she gifted you, along with bandages and some disinfectant.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Aciddrop.

items.d: A rubber toy bullet. Sankta children keep their own toy guns and fill their pockets with these rubber bullets.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Arene.

items.d: A stump dug up from outside the city. She doesn't know what to do with it either, but she thought you'd like it, so she dug it up for you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Bubble.

items.d: A pair of brand new sneakers. She's very, VERY looking forward to working out with you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Jackie.

items.d: A very heavy toolbag, including a back-up nailgun, many spare parts, and a small figurine she's forgotten in there.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Pinecone.

items.d: An exchange certificate for a pet Metal Crab. After the breeder pledges and stamps, and once the Beanstalk Breeding Company is officially established, this certificate can be exchanged for the adoption of an adorable baby Metal Crab.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Beanstalk.

items.d: A beautiful glowskater. Its faint light can illuminate all throughout the night. By the next day, you're free to let it go.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Indigo.

items.d: A makeup brush of rough craftsmanship. Though it shows signs of age, each brown bristle is clean and very soft.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Roberta.

items.d: Due to how hard they are to grow, this cluster of fluorescent subterranean mushrooms remains miniscule. But still, it represents home.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Chestnut.

items.d: A chunk of firewood frozen absolutely solid. Needs a perfunctory baking to remove moisture content before it can be thrown in the furnace.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Totter.

items.d: A stained self-made hammer-drill. Can be used to drill holes and tighten screws, as well as against people when left without a choice.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Humus.

items.d: A stalk of grass one could mistake for a weed at first glance. Holds a special significance to him. A sharp notch has been cut in the grass's blade—don't worry, he's not trying to hurt you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Verdant.

items.d: A pair of running shoes that fit your feet perfectly. The person who gave you this must have spent a lot of effort asking you to join her on her morning exercise routine.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Fang.

items.d: A wild animal map of the Vouivre Boundary Grassland. The marks on it are disappearing one after another as the engines of mobile cities roar.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Vanilla.

items.d: A formal hat decorated with a modest amount of feathers. It is suitable for all Laterano festivals.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Plume.

items.d: Simply wrapped candles. The special fragrance they emit is unforgettable.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Melantha.

items.d: A sled made of hard wood. It makes you look forward to seeing snow.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Cardigan.

items.d: Transcripts neatly placed inside a folder. They all show straight A's.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Beagle.

items.d: A collection of shooting toys, including a plastic bow, several sucker arrows and an apple to be used as a target.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Kroos.

items.d: A specially processed sheath. It is covered in deliberately mysterious patterns.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Lava.

items.d: A daily schedule custom made for your own healthy living. To be honest, it's hard to reject it.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Hibiscus.

items.d: A portable blood pressure meter. Hope you can take good care of yourself even without a medic around.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Ansel.

items.d: A trendy sport armlet. Looks like it's a simple version with only one color.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Steward.

items.d: A delicate pen that has been lovingly packaged. It feels like working in a office building when you use it to review documents.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Orchid.

items.d: A nameplate worn only by soldiers. Now that she is free, she has handed over her glory to you.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Catapult.

items.d: A delicate goblet. Under the yellow light, it gives off intoxicating colors.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Midnight.

items.d: A slang dictionary. It tells how to be gently sarcastic in the languages of several countries.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Spot.

items.d: A solid metal toy. It's particularly heavy and hard to destroy.
items.u: Used to improve the Potential of Popukar.

items.d: 'Stop pulling up the corners of your mouth into that stiff smile and try being more like an Originium slug. Open up your shell, spread out your soft parts, and... Believe me, do that, and you'll get over the awkwardness real quick.'
items.u: An emote set based on Originium slugs, used to communicate between partners.
